mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has reduced Move Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing @FinalDamage@ magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by @SlowValue@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain @BonusAARange@ Attack Range and deal an additional @AutoDamage@ magic damage and consume the Notes.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Every third basic ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note on each nearby ally whenever she casts an ability (Notes last @NoteDuration@ seconds and stack up to @MaxNotes@ per ally). For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain @BonusAARange@ Attack Range and deal an additional @AutoDamage@ magic damage and consume the Notes.

Notes from allies deal @AllyNoteDamagePercent*100@% damage.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Seraphine's next basic spell cast will Echo.
Seraphine's next basic attack has bonus range and deals additional magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Seraphine deals damage in an area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to <magicDamage>@TotalEmpoweredDamage@ damage</magicDamage> below @ExecuteThreshold*100@% Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for @RChannelDuration@ seconds and deals @R1TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.
Seraphine will heal nearby allied champions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them @HasteValueAllies@ Move Speed, herself @WMSBonusTotal@ decaying Move Speed and both @ShieldValueSeraphine@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring @WMissingHPHeal@% missing Health to them after a @WHealSplitDelay@ second delay.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability only heals once, even if cast twice.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has increased Move Speed. Such grace!
This unit is shielded from damage.
